verdict.rationale: The firm's Early-stage/Pre-seed page explicitly states expertise with SAFEs and convertible notes for initial pre-seed raises, backed by a broader stated early-stage financing practice, high venture financing volume (1,600+ deals, $45B+ since 2023), and PitchBook's top VC law firm ranking. Missing for 10: no dedicated published explainer/blog on SAFE mechanics or downloadable SAFE/convertible note forms, and no independent third-party corroboration of pre-seed-specific outcomes.
